video_goal: Demonstrate how to check the electronic oil level and top up the engine oil using Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 in a BMW 3 Series (G20).
required_subjects_and_props: BMW 3 Series (G20) vehicle, iDrive infotainment system, Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 oil bottle, plastic funnel, microfiber cloth

outline_steps.visual_action: A hand presses the engine start/stop button on the BMW G20 dashboard to turn on the vehicle's electronics.
A hand rotates the iDrive controller dial, selecting 'Car', then 'Vehicle status', and finally clicking on 'Engine oil level' on the central display screen.
The iDrive screen displays a digital engine graphic with a yellow bar indicating the oil level is below the 'Max' line.
A hand pulls the '2x' hood release lever located in the driver's side footwell twice in quick succession.
Hands lift the front hood of the BMW G20, revealing the longitudinal engine layout and plastic engine cover.
Fingers grip the circular oil filler cap on top of the engine cover, twist it counter-clockwise, and lift it off.
A clean, red plastic funnel is inserted directly into the open oil filler hole on the engine block.
Hands hold a gold Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 bottle, twist off the red plastic cap, and peel back the silver foil seal.
The gold Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 bottle is tilted, pouring a steady stream of amber oil into the red funnel.
The funnel is lifted out of the hole, and a blue microfiber cloth wipes away a small drip from the rim of the filler neck.
The oil filler cap is placed back onto the hole and twisted clockwise until a distinct click is visually registered by the hand stopping.
Hands pull the BMW hood down and drop it from about a foot high to securely latch it shut.
The iDrive screen updates, showing the digital oil level bar filling up to the green 'Max' line with an 'OK' status.
